retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel cassette insert featuring a central band portrait, vertical spine text, and a dense, right-aligned catalog list.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel horizontal layout designed for a cassette case, featuring a photographic cover with a diagonal title banner, a vertical spine with bold block lettering, and a text-heavy back panel utilizing varied weights of serif and sans-serif fonts for hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical spine text acting as a structural divider between panels
Diagonal banner overlaying the primary photographic subject
Dense, multi-columnar text alignment on the interior/back panel
High-contrast barcode and technical logos at the base of the front panel
coreInvariants: Mix of bold display type and fine-print technical data

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Group portrait occupies the top two-thirds of the central panel; text dominates the side panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, red vertical title on the spine serves as the primary focal point for identification.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central photo to the red spine text, then scan the detailed list on the right panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White backgrounds on the spine and back panel provide high legibility for dense information.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black-on-white with a single saturated primary accent color.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to white, black, and one primary accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of heavy slab-serifs and condensed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Spine title uses ultra-bold, condensed slab-serifs
Catalog headers use bold, all-caps sans-serif
Track details use light-weight serif fonts
characterSpecificRedesigns: Spine text is rotated 90 degrees clockwise
Cover title is set on a diagonal upward slant
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, colorful display face with a neutral, functional sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed feel of the spine text
Matches the utilitarian feel of the catalog headers

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a three-panel layout with a vintage 1980s group photo in the center panel, leaving the side panels and bottom of the center panel as flat white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical red condensed slab-serif text to the spine panel; add a diagonal black banner with white serif text to the photo; add a dense list of black sans-serif text to the right panel.

verificationChecks: Is the spine text oriented vertically?
Is the cover title on a diagonal banner?
Is there a clear hierarchy between artist names and track titles?
Is the color palette restricted to white, black, and red?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (red can be swapped for blue or green)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles

avoid: Contemporary sans-serif fonts like Helvetica Neue

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the barcode looks functional and period-appropriate
Check that the spine text is rotated correctly for a cassette case
Verify the diagonal banner does not obscure faces in the photo
Confirm the technical logos are generic and not trademarked
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vintage group portrait with a vertical red spine and a dense, right-aligned catalog list on a white background.
